native_tools: Clang 20.1.3, lld-link and llvm-lib in ALL four arms
scope: Compiler/sysroot pilot; not a full release or deployment recommendation
cache_policy: No compiler-cache service, N/A hit rate; fresh objects per producer and fresh targets per consumer block
cargo_policy: Common checksum-identical stage0 Cargo from baseline
stdlib_policy: Explicit compiler-isolation control: verify originals then use baseline native target libraries for all four arms; retain original compiler drivers and publish evaluated manifests. Not an untouched-package comparison.
order: Four-sequence Williams design, rotate sequence by VM and round; each arm occupies each position equally across VMs
qualification: Own-package compiler smoke, loaded-driver identity, shared-stdlib compiler smoke and native IronRDP correctness per arm/VM, workspace --tests honoring test=false; no doctests/full distribution qualification
measurement: Five original offline frozen Cargo commands, four-LP inherited affinity; setup, identity checks, copies, correctness and transfers outside timers
analysis: Average rounds within VM, equal-weight VM means, 10000 seeded paired whole-VM bootstrap draws; four VMs and one build per arm do not estimate build-to-build variance
contrasts: baseline->rust,baseline->llvm,rust->both,llvm->both,baseline->both; multiplicative interaction 100*(both*baseline/(rust*llvm)-1), negative means extra benefit beyond multiplicative independence
exclusions: Fixed warmup only; reject failed/incomplete matrices, mixed attempts, identity mismatches; no slow-sample trimming
production: Separate hosted build times are provenance only, not isolated production gains
interpretation: Identify Rust/LLVM contributions and interaction on this fixed version; do not subtract from historical 1.94.1 or Microsoft-linked estimates
